description: A stately deep blue knee-length wool tunic with intricate gold tablet-woven geometric borders at the neck, front placket, cuffs and hem, over fine cream linen visible at the collar and wrists. A rich muted burgundy cloak with woven edging is fastened by two round metal shoulder brooches linked by a chain. A wide dark decorated belt with engraved round fittings and a long hanging strap secures the waist. Brown trousers and brown leather knee-high boots with woven strap edging complete the clothing. No headgear, armor or weapons.
